_about: Kanto chapters, in the order the natural playthrough took them (natural-run-v100 rows 117–144, natural-run-v101 rows 145–162).

chapters.title: The S.S. Aqua
chapters.goal: Collect the S.S. Ticket, upgrade your Pokédex and sail to Kanto.
quick: Talk to Elm in New Bark Town
He calls as soon as you continue after the credits. At his desk he gives you the S.S. Ticket.
Fly to Olivine and walk south to the port
Professor Oak is inside: he upgrades your Pokédex to National Mode.
Board the ship
Show the ticket to the sailor.
Find the lost girl
A grandfather on deck has lost his granddaughter. Wake the sailor napping in the north-west cabin, then go through B1F to the Captain’s room.
Receive the Metal Coat
From the grandfather once she is back.
Disembark
The ship arrives; talk to the sailor by the door.

p: On deck a grandfather runs into you: his granddaughter is missing. The sailor on duty below blocks the corridor until a missing colleague returns. That colleague, Sailor Stanly, is asleep in the cabin at the north-west of 1F; battle him and he goes back to work.
Take the east stairs down to B1F, cross it, and come up in the western section of 1F. The Captain’s room is there. The girl stands behind the desk: talk to her from the side.
After the reunion the grandfather gives you a Metal Coat. Return to the deck; the ship docks at Vermilion and the sailor by the door lets you off.
Arriving in Kanto resets nothing you own, but Kanto’s eight Badges are a fresh set and the Leaders here are Level 56–69.

items: From Professor Elm in his lab after the Johto League.
From the grandfather on the S.S. Aqua after you find his granddaughter.
stuck: What do I do after the Johto credits?
Choose Continue. You are in New Bark Town; talk to Professor Elm at his desk for the S.S. Ticket, then Fly to Olivine.
A sailor blocks the corridor on the ship
Wake Sailor Stanly in the north-west cabin on 1F and beat him. He returns to duty and the way opens.

chapters.title: Vermilion City
chapters.goal: Find the two hidden switches and beat Lt. Surge.
need: Nothing. Vermilion Gym is open on arrival.
quick: Heal at the Pokémon Center
Kanto’s trainers start around Level 56.
Search the trash cans in the Gym
Two of them hide switches. Finding both opens the door to Surge.
Beat Lt. Surge
Reward: Thunder Badge and TM34 Shock Wave.
Leave by the north exit
Steven meets you and asks you to choose Latios or Latias.

p: Three trainers (Magneton, Electrode and Pikachu users around Level 56–57) stand among the trash cans. Two cans hide the switches for the electric locks. Their positions are not fixed, so check cans until both locks have opened.
Lt. Surge leads with Electrode and has Lanturn and Magnezone among his six.

At the city’s north exit Steven, Hoenn’s Champion, walks down from Route 6 and asks which you would choose: Latios or Latias. The one you pick begins roaming Kanto. The other can be met later on Southern Island.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Lt. Surge
know: Ground types ignore his Electric moves, but Lanturn’s Water moves answer them. Carry a Grass move.
He is the first Kanto Leader and already has six Pokémon at Level 57–60.

stuck: The Gym’s door to Surge is locked
Check the trash cans. Two of them hide switches; when both are found the motorized door opens.
next: North along Route 6 and through the gate.

chapters.title: Saffron City
chapters.goal: Work through the teleporter maze to Sabrina.
quick: Enter Saffron from Route 6
Heal at the Pokémon Center.
Solve the warp pads
Each pad always leads to the same place. Nine jumps reach Sabrina’s room.
Beat Sabrina
Reward: Marsh Badge and TM48 Skill Swap.

p: The Gym is a grid of small rooms joined by warp pads, and each pad always leads to the same place. The playthrough reached Sabrina’s room in nine jumps by taking, in every new room, a pad it had not used yet. The Gym’s area map shows every pad.
Her Alakazam Mega Evolves. Mr. Mime leads at Level 65.
To leave, step south onto the three tiles at the entrance.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Sabrina
know: Dark types are immune to her Psychic moves; Bug, Ghost and Dark moves hit hardest.
Mega Alakazam is very fast and frail: priority moves or a bulky Dark type finish it.

stuck: I’m lost in Sabrina’s warp pads
Each pad always leads to the same place. In each new room use a pad you have not tried; the Gym’s area map shows them all.

chapters.title: Cerulean City
chapters.goal: Recover the Power Plant’s missing part, fetch Misty from the cape and beat her.
need: Surf, to reach the Power Plant along the river on Route 10.
quick: Reach Cerulean by Route 5
The Gym is empty for now.
Go to the Power Plant
East on Route 9 to Route 10, then Surf down the river to the plant’s bank.
Talk to the manager in the back room
Then walk back through the hall: an officer asks for help.
Return to Cerulean Gym
A Rocket grunt bumps into you and runs.
Route 24
Find him hiding behind the couple, battle him, and learn where the part is.
Pick up the Machine Part in the Gym
Face its tile from the land tile to the east of it.
Return the part
The manager gives TM25 Thunder.
Routes 24 and 25: the cape
Beat the six trainers; Misty is at the far end and goes back to her Gym.
Beat Misty
Reward: Cascade Badge and TM03 Water Pulse.

p: Route 9’s first crossing into Route 10 lands in a ledge pocket you can only leave the way you came; use the lower crossing. The Power Plant stands on the southern half of Route 10. From the northern half, Surf onto the river and follow it south to the plant’s bank.

The staff in the hall complain about a stolen generator part, but nothing moves forward until you speak to the manager in the back room. Walk back out through the hall and an officer stops you: a suspicious character was seen in Cerulean.

In Cerulean Gym a grunt runs into you and flees. On Route 24, north of the city, he hides behind a couple; talk to him. He has a single Level 30 Koffing. Beaten, he admits he hid the Machine Part in the Gym.
Back in the Gym the camera shows the spot in the water. Stand on the land tile directly east of it and face it to pick the part up. Facing it from the water does nothing.
Return it to the manager for TM25 Thunder. This is also what later earns you the Radio Upgrade in Lavender Town.

Six trainers in a row hold Route 24 and 25 (Level 55–57), followed by a seventh who insists he is not one of them. At the cape Misty is on a date and is not pleased to see you. She returns to her Gym, and so do its trainers.
Misty leads with Golduck at Level 62 and has Vaporeon behind it.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Misty
know: Electric and Grass moves are both super effective on most of her team.

items: Hidden in the water of Cerulean Gym once the Route 24 grunt confesses. Pick it up from the land tile east of it.
From the Power Plant manager when you return the Machine Part.
stuck: Cerulean Gym is empty
Misty is at the cape on Route 25 and only appears there after you return the Machine Part to the Power Plant.
Nothing happens at the Power Plant
Talk to the manager in the back room, then walk back through the hall so the officer stops you.
I can’t pick up the Machine Part
Stand on the land tile to the east of the marked water tile and face it. It cannot be picked up while Surfing.
How do I reach the Power Plant?
From the north part of Route 10, Surf onto the river and follow it south.
next: Fly to Saffron and go east along Route 8.

chapters.title: Lavender Town
chapters.goal: Upgrade your radio, wake the Snorlax in Vermilion and open western Kanto.
need: The Machine Part returned to the Power Plant (the Radio Tower director rewards you for it).
quick: Visit Lavender’s radio station
The director gives you the Radio Upgrade.
Fly to Vermilion
A Snorlax sleeps in front of Diglett’s Cave on the east side.
Tune the Pokégear radio to the Poké Flute
Open the Pokégear’s radio and turn the dial left until the flute plays.
Talk to Snorlax
It wakes and attacks at Level 50.
Walk through Diglett’s Cave
It comes out on Route 2, south of Pewter City.

p: Cerulean’s Route 4 only runs downhill from Mt. Moon, and the guard in the Reception Gate will not let you into Route 22 yet. The way to western Kanto is past the sleeping Snorlax on Vermilion’s east side.

First get the Radio Upgrade from the director of Lavender’s radio station: he gives it to the Trainer who fixed the Power Plant. Then stand beside Snorlax, open the Pokégear, choose the radio and turn the dial to the far left until the Poké Flute channel plays. Close the Pokégear with the music still playing and talk to Snorlax.
It can be caught. Once it has moved, the guard in the Reception Gate also stands down, opening Route 22 and Viridian City from the west.

items: From the director of Lavender’s radio station after the Power Plant is fixed. Adds Kanto stations to the Pokégear.
stuck: How do I wake Snorlax?
Stand next to it, open the Pokégear radio and tune left to the Poké Flute channel. Leave it playing and talk to Snorlax. You need the Radio Upgrade from Lavender Town.
The Lavender director gives me nothing
Return the Machine Part to the Power Plant first (Cerulean City chapter).
How do I get to Pewter City?
Through Diglett’s Cave, behind the Vermilion Snorlax. Route 4 from Cerulean is one-way the other direction.
next: Diglett’s Cave to Route 2, then north.

chapters.title: Pewter City
chapters.goal: Cut through to Pewter and beat Brock.
need: Cut (in your Bag) for the tree outside Diglett’s Cave on Route 2.
quick: Cut the tree on Route 2
It closes off the pocket where Diglett’s Cave comes out.
Walk north to Pewter
Heal at the Pokémon Center.
Beat Brock
Reward: Boulder Badge and TM80 Rock Slide.

p: One trainer, Jerry, stands before Brock. Brock leads with Golem at Level 66 and brings Aerodactyl, Kabutops and Kleavor among his six.
The Boulder Badge is one of the two Badges the Ash story in Viridian Forest later checks for; the other is Misty’s.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Brock
know: Water and Grass do well, but his fossils and Kleavor are fast: do not rely on a slow Water type alone.
Fighting moves hit most of the team.

stuck: I’m boxed in outside Diglett’s Cave
Face the small tree south of the exit and press A. Cut only needs to be in your Bag.
next: Fly to Saffron and walk west along Route 7.

chapters.title: Celadon City
chapters.goal: Cut into the Gym’s garden and beat Erika.
need: Cut (in your Bag) for the trees inside the Gym.
quick: Walk Route 7 from Saffron
Celadon is the next city west.
Cut a tree inside the Gym
Three trees block the hall.
Beat Erika
Reward: Rainbow Badge and TM19 Giga Drain.

p: A row of three small trees crosses the hall just inside. Cut the middle one. Three trainers (Victreebel, Parasect and Jumpluff users) wait in the garden. Erika leads with Jumpluff at Level 61 and has Tangrowth.
Celadon’s Department Store sells TMs on its third floor and is worth a visit before the later Gyms.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Erika
know: Fire, Flying and Ice moves are super effective on most of her team.

stuck: I can’t get further into Celadon Gym
Cut one of the three small trees across the hall.
next: Fly to Lavender and go south: Routes 12, 13, 14 and 15.

chapters.title: Fuchsia City
chapters.goal: Take the long way south from Lavender and find the real Janine.
need: Surf, to cross the water on Route 12.
quick: South from Lavender on Route 12
Cross on the water and leave by the exit further east, not the first one.
Routes 13, 14 and 15
Walk through the gate building on Route 15.
Fuchsia Gym
Invisible walls and four look-alikes. The real Janine is in the west of the room.
Beat Janine
Reward: Soul Badge and TM84 Poison Jab.
Do not jump down to Route 19’s beach yet
It is blocked until Blaine is beaten.

p: Route 12’s first southern exit drops you into a two-tile pocket of Route 13 that leads nowhere: Surf back and use the exit further east. Trainers on Routes 13 to 15 are Level 56–61.
In Fuchsia Gym the walls are invisible and four trainers are disguised as Janine. The real one stands on the west side. Her lead is Weezing at Level 63.

South of Fuchsia, ledges drop to a beach crowded with Kingler that block the way to the water. They leave only after Blaine is beaten. The ledges are one-way, so if you jump down now you can only get out by Flying. Reach Cinnabar from Pallet Town instead.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Janine
know: Ground and Psychic moves are super effective on most of her team.

stuck: I’m stuck in a tiny patch of Route 13
You took Route 12’s first southern exit. Surf back north and use the exit further east.
I jumped down to the Route 19 beach and can’t leave
The Kingler block the water until Blaine is beaten. Fly out.
next: Through the Reception Gate onto Route 22.

chapters.title: Viridian City
chapters.goal: Enter western Kanto and reach Cinnabar Island by sea.
need: Snorlax woken in Vermilion (this removes the guard in the Reception Gate).
quick: Fly to New Bark Town and go back to the Reception Gate
Routes 27 and 26 again. The guard on the east corridor is gone.
Take the south exit to Route 22
Stand on the arrow tile and press Down.
Viridian City
Heal. The Gym’s Leader is away.
Route 1 to Pallet Town
Professor Oak’s lab is here.
Surf south on Route 21
Cinnabar Island is at the end.

p: With Snorlax gone, the Black Belt in the Reception Gate has left the east corridor. The exit to Route 22 is a south-pointing arrow tile: stand on it and press Down. Viridian City is a short walk east.
You can also reach Viridian on foot from Pewter through Viridian Forest. Until Red is beaten, the clearing by the forest’s south gate is just a clearing.
Route 1 leads south to Pallet Town, and Route 21 is open water from Pallet’s shore to Cinnabar Island.

stuck: The Reception Gate guard blocks Route 22
Wake the Snorlax in Vermilion City (Lavender Town chapter). That clears him.
Viridian Gym has no Leader
Blue is on Cinnabar Island. He returns once you hold fifteen Badges and talk to him there.

chapters.title: Cinnabar Island
chapters.goal: Find Blaine’s temporary Gym in the Seafoam Islands, then meet Blue on Cinnabar.
quick: Surf east from Cinnabar on Route 20
Use the eastern cave door of the Seafoam Islands.
Find the Gym inside
A doorway on 1F leads into Blaine’s Gym.
Beat Blaine
Reward: Volcano Badge and TM50 Overheat.
Return to Cinnabar and talk to Blue
With fifteen Badges he agrees to go back to Viridian Gym.

p: Cinnabar’s Gym burned down, so Blaine has set up inside the Seafoam Islands. From Cinnabar only the eastern door of the islands can be reached. Inside, the Gym is a short walk away. Blaine leads with Rapidash at Level 66 and has Magmortar, Houndoom and Camerupt.
The Gym’s own way out leads to a small northern islet with no route onward: go back through the cave to the east door.
Blue stands on Cinnabar Island looking at the volcano. Once you have fifteen Badges, talking to him sends him back to his Gym in Viridian City. Beating Blaine also clears the Kingler from Route 19.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Blaine
know: Water, Ground and Rock all work. Camerupt is four times weak to Water.

stuck: Where is Cinnabar’s Gym?
Inside the Seafoam Islands. Surf east from Cinnabar on Route 20 and use the eastern cave door.
Blue won’t go to his Gym
He only leaves Cinnabar when you have all seven other Kanto Badges.

chapters.title: Viridian Gym
chapters.goal: Win the sixteenth Badge and report to Professor Oak.
need: Fifteen Badges and the talk with Blue on Cinnabar Island.
quick: Cross the spinner floor
Arrow tiles send you sliding until a stop tile.
Beat Blue
Reward: Earth Badge and TM92 Trick Room.
Answer Oak’s call
It comes as you leave the Gym.
Visit Oak’s lab in Pallet Town
He reopens the Kanto League for you and clears the way to Mt. Silver.

p: Blue has no single type: Rhyperior (Level 69) leads, with Exeggutor, Pidgeot, Machamp, Tyranitar and Arcanine behind. Plan for coverage rather than one counter.

Outside, Professor Oak phones and asks you to come to his lab. In Pallet Town he congratulates you on sixteen Badges. Two things change: the Kanto League at the Indigo Plateau will accept your challenge again with stronger teams, and the guard on the Reception Gate’s west door leaves, opening Route 28 and Mt. Silver.

bosses.title: Gym Leader Blue
know: Six different types. Water covers Rhyperior, Tyranitar and Arcanine; Ice or Electric for Pidgeot and Exeggutor.

stuck: What now that I have sixteen Badges?
Talk to Professor Oak in his lab in Pallet Town. Then choose: the Kanto League rematch at the Indigo Plateau, or Mt. Silver by the Reception Gate’s west door.

chapters.title: The Kanto League
chapters.goal: Beat the Elite Four’s rematch teams and Lance to become Kanto Champion.
need: Sixteen Badges and Professor Oak’s scene in his lab.
quick: Stock up at the League Center
Full Restore ¥3,000, Max Potion ¥2,500, Revive ¥1,500, Full Heal ¥600, Hyper Potion ¥1,200.
Same rooms, same order
Will, Koga, Bruno, Karen, Lance. Six Pokémon each, Level 66–70, each with a Mega Evolution.
Hall of Fame and credits
Continue resumes in New Bark Town as Kanto Champion.

p: The five fight in the same rooms and the same order, and every return to the League Center still restarts from Will. All carry two Full Restores. Will’s Slowbro, Bruno’s Heracross, Karen’s Houndoom and Lance’s Dragonite Mega Evolve.

Status and confusion do most of the damage: Supersonic, Confuse Ray, Swagger, Toxic, Lovely Kiss and Sing. Lance’s Gyarados (Waterfall) and Aerodactyl (Rock Slide) punish Rock, Ground, Flying and Fire teams in turn. In the playthrough a party at Level 79–91 with Full Restores won; Rock moves decided the Champion fight.
Each loss costs roughly ¥10,000 at this level. Beating Lance pays ¥14,000. Afterwards Mary and Professor Oak appear, you enter the Hall of Fame and the credits play again.

bosses.title: Champion Lance
know: Rock moves hit Salamence, Gyarados, Aerodactyl, Charizard and Altaria at least neutrally and most of them hard.
Mega Dragonite is still four times weak to Ice.

stuck: Is the Kanto League required?
It is not what unlocks Hoenn. Hoenn opens through Red at Mt. Silver and the Ash story in Viridian Forest. The playthrough did the League first.
next: Fly to Viridian, west on Route 22, and through the Reception Gate’s west door.
chapters.ev: v101 trace 145–149; website notes ‘Kanto League (rematch after 16 badges)’

chapters.title: Mt. Silver
chapters.goal: Climb to the summit and defeat Red.
need: Sixteen Badges and Oak’s scene (the guard on the Reception Gate’s west door leaves).
quick: Viridian → Route 22 → Reception Gate
Leave by the west door onto Route 28.
Surf across Route 28’s pond
Mt. Silver’s Pokémon Center is outside the cave.
Climb
Waterfall room, mountain side, back inside by the upper door, up the waterfall, then alternate between 2F and the snow three times to 3F and the summit.
Run from wild Pokémon on the way up
Arrive with full HP and PP.
Battle Red
Level 75–93.

p: There are twelve doorways between the entrance and the summit. From the entrance go through the 1F waterfall room out onto the mountain side, re-enter 1F by the upper door, and ride the waterfall up to 2F. From there the route passes out into the snow and back into 2F three times before reaching 3F and the top.

Wild Pokémon run from Level 39 to 60. Items on the way include a Full Restore, Max Potion, Dire Hit and Ultra Ball on 1F and a Rare Candy and Never-Melt Ice in the snow. The summit has a day layout and a night layout.

Red stands at the peak in falling snow and says nothing. His Pikachu is Level 93 with a Light Ball: its Surf removes Rock and Ground leads, and its Thunderbolt removes Water and Flying ones. Open with a Fighting type that can take one hit.

His Charizard Mega Evolves into Mega Charizard X. Snorlax, Venusaur, Blastoise (Quick Claw) and Espeon complete the team; he uses two Full Restores. If you lose you wake outside Mt. Silver’s Pokémon Center.
When he is beaten he fades from the summit. Continue from a save afterwards and you start in New Bark Town.

bosses.title: Pokémon Trainer Red
know: Lead with a Fighting type for Pikachu; keep a Rock or Ground move for Mega Charizard X.
Blastoise’s Quick Claw can move first at any time. Do not leave a weakened Pokémon in front of it.

stuck: Someone blocks the west door of the Reception Gate
Collect all sixteen Badges and talk to Professor Oak in his lab.
I arrive at the summit too weak
Run from wild battles on the climb and save your strongest moves’ PP. Heal at the Pokémon Center outside the cave first.
next: Fly to Viridian and walk north on Route 2 into Viridian Forest.

chapters.title: A Promise to Butterfree
chapters.goal: Help Ash, Misty and Brock find a lost Butterfree, then battle Ash.
need: The Boulder Badge (Brock) and the Cascade Badge (Misty).
quick: Enter Viridian Forest from the south
Viridian City, Route 2, then the forest’s south gate.
Step into the clearing
Ash, Pikachu, Butterfree, Brock and Misty are there. Agree to help.
Follow Pikachu north along the east side
It waits at two spots and points the way each time.
Take the sideways stairs to the north-west clearing
The pink Butterfree is there.
Offer her food
Talk to her and say yes.
Battle Ash
Brock heals your team first. Level 64–68, Mega Charizard Y.
Receive Ash’s Pikachu
Then answer Professor Oak’s call.

p: Before Red is beaten nothing happens here. Afterwards, stepping into the clearing just north of the south gate starts the scene: Misty calls you over, Ash introduces himself, and Brock explains that a storm has separated Ash’s Butterfree from its pink partner. Ash asks for your help.
Pikachu runs ahead as a scout while Misty and Brock check the other paths. You can save inside the forest; the story keeps its place.

Walk north along the forest’s eastern side. Pikachu waits at two spots; walking up to it shows pink wing scales and sends it on north. This forest uses HGSS-style diagonal stairs that can only be walked sideways.

The trail bends west. The third spot is a small clearing in the north-west, reached by the sideways stairs on its east edge. The pink Butterfree is there, too tired to fly. Brock and Misty arrive and Brock gives you Pokémon food.
Talk to the pink Butterfree and choose yes to offer the food. Brock checks her wings, Misty fetches Ash, and the two Butterfree fly off together.

Ash then asks for a battle; Brock heals your party first. Losing does not send you away: Ash simply offers again. His Charizard holds Charizardite Y and Mega Evolves; Bulbasaur and Squirtle hold Eviolite; his Pikachu is Level 68 with a Light Ball and Volt Tackle.

When you win, Ash gives you his Pikachu (Level 68, wearing his cap). With a full party you choose a Pokémon to send to the PC on the spot. Professor Oak phones immediately: a friend from Hoenn is visiting.

bosses.title: Pokémon Trainer Ash
know: Mega Charizard Y brings harsh sunlight: his Fire moves hit harder and Water moves are weakened.
Snorlax uses Rest and Sleep Talk. Fighting moves end it fastest.
A loss costs nothing. He offers the battle again.

items: A gift from Ash after the battle. Level 68 with Thunderbolt, Quick Attack, Iron Tail and Volt Tackle.
stuck: Nothing happens in Viridian Forest
You need to have beaten Red on Mt. Silver and to hold both the Boulder Badge and the Cascade Badge. Enter from the south gate and step into the clearing.
I can’t find the pink Butterfree
Follow Pikachu up the east side twice, then go west along the top of the forest and step sideways onto the stairs into the small north-west clearing.
The game froze when I walked into the clearing
That was a bug in v100. It was fixed in v101; update your game.
chapters.ev: v101 trace 155–161; website notes ‘Viridian Forest — Ash’; BLOCKER-001 fixed in v101
